claims.value: In 1945, British Indian central administration remained under the Crown-appointed viceroy, Wavell, with its administrative seat in New Delhi. Its central legislature continued the 1919 Act framework; the federation contemplated by the 1935 Act had never operated. These institutions do not establish uniform direct rule over princely states.
